33781944b6d4.en: The campaign **takes place in the world of the light novels but doesn't follow their story**. Canon characters are NPCs and rumors at most. By default it's the **1040s A.G.** — the DM decides the exact year and who's alive.

45f90c1109d3.t: 战斗使用常规的**先攻**（阿尔法原文说行动顺序按AC决定）。

46f8b5ebc00a.en: You're a badge-carrying **Pearl adventurer** working out of a Forway **embassy**. Grab a quest off the board, sign the contract in blood, gather whoever's free tonight, and head out into a world full of walking killer trees, moody undead castles, bandits, bureaucracy and food. Climb from **Pearl to Sapphire**. Try not to die — and if you do, hope someone drags your body back before your soul dissolves, because Forway *will* revive you... and take half your pay until the debt is paid.
46f8b5ebc00a.t: 你是一名持有身份牌的**珀尔级冒险者**，在福威的**大使馆**接活。从委托板上揭下一张委托，用血签下合同，叫上今晚有空的人，出发去一个满是会走路的杀人树、喜怒无常的亡灵城堡、强盗、官僚和美食的世界。从**珀尔**一路升到**萨菲尔**。尽量别死——要是死了，就祈祷有人在你的灵魂溶解前把你的尸体拖回来，因为福威*一定*会复活你……然后拿走你一半的报酬，直到你还清债务。

5aec0323882b.en: **One shared world.** Whatever a party kills, maps, angers or befriends stays that way for everyone. Keep a shared **session log** and mark traveled and explored circles on a shared copy of the **travel map**.
5aec0323882b.t: **一个共享的世界。** 一支队伍杀掉的、画进地图的、惹恼的或结交的，对所有人来说都会保持那样。记一份共享的**跑团日志**，并在共享的**旅行地图**副本上标出走过和探索过的圈。

5e443f1e5a75.en: Pre-gens cleaned up: **Hiromi** is now a Darfaries brawler (matching the lore), and his old interrogator kit moved to a new pre-gen, **Takeo**. Every sheet lists its people, interface and Soul Points.
5e443f1e5a75.t: 整理了预制角色：**弘美**现在是一名达尔法里斯格斗家（与设定一致），他原来的审讯工具包挪给了新的预制角色**武雄**。每张角色卡都列出了种族、界面和灵魂点数。

69a25b5f9d3b.en: A **West Marches** style D&D 5e campaign set in the world of #HusbandOutWorld. It grew out of the original Alpha wagon-escort one-shot (now kept here as the [Alpha One-Shot](Alpha%20One-Shot%20-%20Wagon%20Escort.md)), expanded into an open table.
69a25b5f9d3b.t: 一个以#HusbandOutWorld世界为背景的**西境**（West Marches）式D&D 5e战役。它源自最初的阿尔法货车护送单次冒险（现保存在这里，即[阿尔法单次冒险](Alpha%20One-Shot%20-%20Wagon%20Escort.md)），后来扩展成了一张开放的游戏桌。

8b69dc373c04.t: 货车护送现在是众多**委托类型之一**（货物护送）；保留了每天的四个**时段**。

916411d820c2.en: No kilometers, no Egua speeds, no load percentages. The [travel map](../Maps) has circles drawn along the routes connecting places. **Count the circles to the destination. Each circle represents 1, 2 or 3 days — the DM chooses** (Fast, Standard, Slow) to make the journey shorter or longer. Forway to Sanbi is 6 circles, so 6, 12 or 18 days. Every route's length is in the [Maps](../Maps) table, and the website's travel planner counts them for you. Details in [Travel by Circles](01%20-%20Travel%20by%20Circles.md).
916411d820c2.t: 不用公里，不用埃瓜速度，不用负重百分比。[旅行地图](../Maps)上沿着连接各地的路线画着圈。**数一数到目的地有几个圈。每个圈代表1、2或3天——由DM选择**（快速、标准、慢速），让旅程变短或变长。福威到桑比是6个圈，所以是6、12或18天。每条路线的长度都在[地图](../Maps)的表格里，网站上的旅行计划也会帮你数。详见[按圈旅行](01%20-%20Travel%20by%20Circles.md)。

99f71fd1e62e.t: 新增了灵魂能量、西吉尔戒指、纳里凝胶、复活债、级别、委托、事件、派系和危险之地的规则。

a34c7942af55.en: **Players drive.** Before a session, the players pick a **quest** from the board (or a rumor, a ruin, a spot on the map they want to explore) and tell the DM. The DM preps that.
a34c7942af55.t: **玩家主导。** 跑团前，玩家从委托板上挑一个**委托**（或者一条传闻、一处遗迹、地图上他们想探索的某个地方），然后告诉DM。DM就准备那个。

aa7cfe4138eb.en: **Start and end at an embassy.** Every session starts at an embassy city (the hub is **Forway**) and should end with the party back at any embassy, or at least in a safe town. If they're still out in the wild when the session ends, the **quest deadline** keeps ticking (see [Death, Revival & Debt](05%20-%20Death,%20Revival%20&%20Debt.md)).
aa7cfe4138eb.t: **从大使馆出发，在大使馆结束。** 每次跑团都从一座有大使馆的城市开始（据点是**福威**），并且最好以队伍回到任意一座大使馆，或至少回到一个安全的城镇结束。如果跑团结束时他们还在野外，**委托期限**就会继续计算（见[死亡、复活与债务](05%20-%20Death,%20Revival%20&%20Debt.md)）。

b453f5e0c2fb.en: The big simplification: travel by circles

b9f21f338f90.en: Whatever makes the game more fun — do it. Turn the circle knob, ignore a rule, invent a village. If you have a proposal, send a PR. If you run a game, tell us — we love pics!
b9f21f338f90.t: 只要能让游戏更好玩——就去做。转动圈数旋钮，无视某条规则，编一个村子出来。如果你有提议，就发个PR。如果你带了一场跑团，告诉我们——我们超爱看照片！

c13eb9d63982.en: **Open table.** There's a pool of players, not a fixed party. Anyone can propose a session; whoever signs up that day is the party (3–6 is ideal).
c13eb9d63982.t: **开放的游戏桌。** 这里有一群玩家，而不是固定的队伍。任何人都可以提议开一次跑团；当天报名的人就是这次的队伍（3–6人最理想）。
